name: Singing Crystal Shard
summary: Singing Crystal Shards are valuable blue crystals found in Stranglethorn Vale. Basilisks there eat the crystals, hardening their skin.

sections.title: Crystal and Scale
sections.body: In Stranglethorn Vale, basilisks eat Singing Crystals, and the crystals harden their skin. A shard can sometimes be harvested from them. Crank Fizzlebub says the crystals are unique to Stranglethorn and valuable to certain parties. The Venture Company makes it difficult for him to gather them.

faq.answer: Singing Crystal Shards are pieces of crystals found in Stranglethorn Vale. Basilisks eat the crystals, which harden their skin.

faq.q: Why do basilisks have hardened skin?
faq.answer: Basilisks in Stranglethorn Vale eat Singing Crystals, and the crystals harden their skin.

faq.q: Where can I find the shards?
faq.answer: Singing Crystal Shards can be harvested from basilisks in Stranglethorn Vale.

faq.q: Why does Crank Fizzlebub want them?
faq.answer: Crank Fizzlebub says the crystals are valuable to certain parties, and he can move them for a profit.

faq.q: What does the Venture Company have to do with the crystals?
faq.answer: The Venture Company makes it difficult for Crank Fizzlebub to gather the crystals.
